critical_code_review_comments: RCA FOUND (fixed): In /app/backend/server.py the router include order registered routes_uploads (which owns wildcard `/files/{path:path}`) BEFORE routes_library (which owns `/files/private/{file_id}`). FastAPI matches in insertion order, so every GET /api/files/private/xxx was being routed to routes_uploads.serve_file, which looks up db.uploads.find_one({storage_path: 'private/xxx'}) → None → 404 'File not found'. This shadowed ALL private file downloads (Bearer and signed-token) even though POST /library/files correctly wrote both the Mongo record and the object to storage. Fix: register routes_library.router BEFORE routes_uploads.router so the more specific literal `/files/private/{file_id}` wins the match. Verified by reproducing (upload 201, download 404) and confirming the fix (both Bearer and signed-URL return 200 image/png 67 bytes). The smoke_studio.py never exercised the download path, which is why this shipped.

storage.py::init_storage caches _storage_key in module scope; a fresh init call from a separate Python process returns a different key, but the emergent object store treats writes made with either key as globally visible (verified empirically). That means multiple backend workers all initing their own keys is safe — no cross-worker file invisibility. Good.

routes_library.py::download_private_file catches ALL exceptions from get_object and converts to 404 — this masks real storage outages (would return same 404 whether the file was never uploaded or the storage service is down). Consider logging exc.__class__.__name__ before the raise so ops can differentiate.

routes_landing.py::submit_lead correctly requires the crm module flag (line 136) — a coach who disables CRM effectively also disables their public lead forms. Emails are lowercased at insert (line 140) so contact matching stays case-insensitive.

modules.py::require_course_access returns 402 (Payment Required) for paused enrollments — semantically nice for the client's UI to distinguish 'you're locked, pay to resume' from generic 403. Confirmed with test_paused_enrollment_returns_402_on_course_read.

memberships.py::activate_subscription is idempotent and stacks renewals — if a webhook fires twice for the same session_id, the routes_payments._fulfill 'active' guard blocks the second call. Combined with the webhook_events insert-on-first-seen dedup, replays are safe.

routes_assistant.py::create_draft double-guards — require_own_client(coach_id, body.client_id) first (so a coach can't even attempt drafting on someone else's client → 404), then the assistant_consents check → 403 without consent. Also strips the `role='coach'` requirement for draft creation via require_coach. Solid.

routes_courses.py::_lesson_public strips content/video_url/attachments for locked lessons (lines 149-152). Backend also 403s /studio/lessons/{id} for unreleased lessons (line 366). Both verified by smoke_studio.py.

routes_community.py::_shape_post correctly scopes reactions/comments/rsvps per post and never leaks the author's private data — only user_id/name/picture/is_coach flag. can_delete is computed server-side (author or coach).

routes_payments.py::create_checkout_session correctly enforces server-side pricing (uses course.price / plan.price, not amount from request body). Also scopes coach_id on the purchase row so /studio/analytics/overview.revenue_total is correctly bucketed per coach.

routes_courses.py::enroll_client is idempotent (re-activates paused/revoked rather than duplicating) — verified by test_enrollment_is_idempotent (two POSTs → still exactly one row in GET /enrollments).

rca_of_issue: BUG: All GET /api/files/private/{file_id} calls (both Bearer-token and signed ?t= paths) returned 404 'File not found', even for the file's owning coach immediately after a successful 201 upload. REPRODUCTION: (1) POST /api/library/files with a valid PNG → 201 with new file_id. (2) GET /api/files/private/{file_id} with the owner's Bearer → 404. Same for signed-token URLs from /library/files/{id}/link. Meanwhile GET /api/library/files (list) returns the file (so DB row exists), direct calls to storage.get_object(storage_path) from a Python REPL succeed (so the object IS in the emergent object store), and the sibling public route GET /api/files/{path:path} used by /api/upload works fine. INVESTIGATION: added a print in storage.get_object → the print fires for /api/upload flows but never for /api/library/files flows, proving control never reached storage.get_object. Traced back: `routes_uploads.router` was included in server.py BEFORE `routes_library.router`. routes_uploads owns wildcard `/files/{path:path}` (public) and routes_library owns literal `/files/private/{file_id}` (authorized). FastAPI matches in insertion order → wildcard captured 'private/xxx' → routes_uploads.serve_file did db.uploads.find_one({storage_path:'private/xxx'}) → None → 404 'File not found'. MITIGATION: swapped the two `api_router.include_router(...)` lines in /app/backend/server.py so routes_library.router comes first. VERIFICATION: repeated the reproduction → 201 upload → 200 image/png 67 bytes on both Bearer download and signed download. Also added 6 tests in test_phase5_platform.py (test_private_file_* + test_share_toggle_grants_client_access) that would catch this regression. Root cause: route registration ordering when two routers share a URL prefix, one of which uses a `{path:path}` catch-all — the more specific literal route MUST be registered first.
